name: recon3d-cross-cell-deg
description: Audit metabolite-mediated routes between two cell types using Recon3D topology and paired DEG evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Audit two-cell metabolic routes and evidence limits.
interface.longDescription: Map DEG-linked reactions across cell types, inspect Recon3D-permitted metabolite routes and GPR-aware RNA evidence, and report what remains unmeasured.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit cross-cell DEG routes with Recon3D and state the evidence limits.
